sourceNote: Built from the current season schedule framework plus recurring patterns in prior Crew workouts and coaching discussions. Historical emails are synthesis sources only.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.purpose: Welcome athletes, establish movement quality, and make the erg understandable.

phases.name: Benchmark + boat prep
phases.purpose: Create a baseline, teach ownership, and prepare the fleet.

phases.name: Water introduction
phases.purpose: Move from commands and set work into controlled first-water rowing.

phases.name: Head-racing build
phases.purpose: Build aerobic durability, technical consistency, and race rhythm.

phases.name: Championship build
phases.purpose: Sharpen race-specific work, protect quality, and arrive ready.

phases.name: Close + transition
phases.purpose: Finish deliberately, recover, and capture what carries forward.

sessions.title: Welcome + Rowing 101
sessions.intent: Explain the practice rhythm, lower the barrier for new rowers, and establish posture and sequence.
sessions.workout: Erg setup; posture; legs-body-arms sequence; 3 x 5 minutes easy technical rowing with 2 minutes reset.
sessions.cue: No pressure. Learn the order first.
sessions.land: Mobility, bodyweight circuit, and easy technical erg work.

sessions.title: Controlled Intervals
sessions.intent: Introduce controlled high-aerobic work without turning the first interval into a sprint.
sessions.workout: 10 minutes easy; 8 x 2 minutes strong / 2 minutes easy; 8 minutes cooldown.
sessions.cue: Make the final effort your best-controlled one.
sessions.land: Same interval structure on ergs; optional rate cap 22–24.

sessions.title: Recovery Order
sessions.intent: Make the recovery quiet, repeatable, and connected to the next drive.
sessions.workout: Hands away → body over → slide; 3 x 8 minutes at 18–20 spm.
sessions.cue: Patient recovery; do not rush the front end.
sessions.land: Mirror sequence with pause drills and low-rate steady state.

sessions.title: Team Conditioning Day
sessions.intent: Build shared effort and general athletic readiness.
sessions.workout: Team run, stairs, or circuit; finish with mobility and a short reflection.
sessions.cue: Conditioning should leave the team better, not buried.

sessions.title: 2K Baseline
sessions.intent: Establish an honest baseline for training zones and future comparison.
sessions.workout: Standard warm-up; 2K test; record each 500 split, average, rate, and post-piece note.
sessions.cue: Even first 500; compete with the plan.

sessions.title: Rigging + Fleet Ownership
sessions.intent: Teach parts, hardware, care, and the reason behind boat readiness.
sessions.workout: Rig boats in order; inspect equipment; review carry commands; debrief common errors.
sessions.land: Rigging and equipment care are the primary plan.

sessions.title: Commands + Safety
sessions.intent: Operate safely before asking the boat to move quickly.
sessions.workout: Carrying, commands, launch sequence, stopping, turning, emergency basics, and dock flow.
sessions.cue: Clear command, clear response, clear action.
sessions.land: Command walk-through and equipment handling rehearsal.

sessions.title: First Water: Set + Sequence
sessions.intent: Make the boat stable and repeatable before adding pressure.
sessions.workout: Short rowing at 16–18 spm; pause work; set drills; legs-first connection.
sessions.land: Low-rate technical erg; pause and pick drill.

sessions.title: Steady State: Find the Range
sessions.intent: Teach athletes to choose sustainable power rather than chase an arbitrary rate.
sessions.workout: 3 x 15 minutes at 18–22 spm, 3 minutes easy between pieces; hold consistent effort.
sessions.cue: If the split falls apart, lower the rate and keep the power.
sessions.land: 3 x 15 minutes on ergs at 18–22 spm, roughly 2K+25–30.

sessions.title: Threshold Pyramid
sessions.intent: Raise aerobic power with controlled changes instead of long high-rate survival work.
sessions.workout: 3 x 10 minutes building 20→22→24 spm, 3 minutes easy between pieces.
sessions.cue: Rate rises only when connection and power remain intact.
sessions.land: Same pyramid on ergs; do not sustain 26+ for long blocks.

sessions.title: Long Aerobic Base
sessions.intent: Build durable aerobic work that supports long head-race efforts.
sessions.workout: 2 x 25 minutes at 18–22 spm, 3 minutes easy; finish with mobility.
sessions.land: 2 x 25 minutes or 2 x 7K at a sustainable 2K+25–30 effort.

sessions.title: Race Rhythm Intervals
sessions.intent: Practice changing rhythm without losing boat connection.
sessions.workout: 4 x 1500m at about 28 spm with 5 minutes recovery; controlled start and finish.
sessions.cue: The rate supports the power; it never replaces it.
sessions.land: Primary erg session; scale by athlete readiness.

sessions.title: Head-Race Simulation
sessions.intent: Link technical consistency, pacing, steering, and race-day communication.
sessions.workout: Long continuous piece with planned rate changes; rehearse start, settle, base, and finish calls.
sessions.cue: Spend the middle of the race rowing your plan.
sessions.land: Progressive long erg piece with the same calls and pacing.

sessions.title: Head of the Fish
sessions.intent: Execute the practiced race plan and learn from the full event day.
sessions.workout: Standard warm-up; 4K race plan; cooldown; quick post-race debrief.

sessions.title: 2K Progress Check
sessions.intent: Measure fall progress without sacrificing recovery or confidence.
sessions.workout: Same warm-up and recording format as baseline; 2K test; compare splits and notes.
sessions.cue: Use the baseline as information, not a verdict.

sessions.title: Race-Specific Alternation
sessions.intent: Blend high and low rhythm while keeping the low-rate work honest.
sessions.workout: 3 x 2000m with alternating 250m at 30 spm / 250m at 16 spm; 5 minutes recovery.
sessions.cue: The low-rate segment still has to move the boat.
sessions.land: Same structure on ergs; scale volume for newer athletes.

sessions.title: Frostbite
sessions.intent: Execute a compact race plan with a deliberate start, settle, and third-500 attack.
sessions.workout: Standard warm-up; race; cooldown; capture one technical win and one next adjustment.
sessions.cue: Start controlled; attack when the plan says.

sessions.title: Recovery + Review
sessions.intent: Recover from racing and identify the habits worth carrying forward.
sessions.workout: Easy movement, mobility, light technical work, and season review.
sessions.land: Easy erg or movement; no forced intensity.

sessions.title: Final Practice + Carry Forward
sessions.intent: Close the fall intentionally and leave the next coach with useful notes.
sessions.workout: Light technical row if safe; otherwise easy movement, equipment check, and written carry-forward notes.
